title: Director of Cannabis Operations
text:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director of Cannabis Operations is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and strategic direction of Northern Light Cannabis Company, including cultivation, processing, retail, distribution, compliance, inventory, financial performance, and administrative operations. The Director provides leadership and guidance to the Operations Manager, Cultivation Manager, and Office Manager to ensure efficient daily operations, regulatory compliance, fiscal responsibility, product quality, and exceptional customer service. This position is responsible for developing operational goals, policies, budgets, and performance expectations while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and employee development. The Director is expected to provide both strategic leadership and hands-on operational support when necessary to ensure the continued success of Northern Light Cannabis Company.

 

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

1. Provide overall leadership, direction, and oversight for all Northern Light Cannabis Company operations, including cultivation, processing, packaging, distribution, retail, inventory, compliance, and administrative functions.

2. Supervise, mentor and evaluate the Operations Manager, Cultivation Manager, and Office Manager, while providing support to all staff.

3. Establish annual goals, operational objectives, and performance expectations that support the mission and strategic direction of Bay Mills Business Holdings.

4. Develop, implement, and maintain policies and standard operating procedures to promote operational consistency, regulatory compliance, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

5. Develop and administer annual operating and capital budgets while monitoring financial performance and recommending corrective actions when necessary.

6. Review operational and financial reports, monitor key performance indicators, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.

7. Work collaboratively with the Accounting Department to ensure accurate financial reporting, inventory valuation, purchasing controls, and compliance with established accounting procedures.

8. Oversee pricing strategies, product mix, purchasing decisions, and inventory planning.

9. Develop and maintain productive relationships with vendors, contractors, wholesale customers, business partners, and regulatory agencies.

10. Ensure compliance with all applicable Tribal laws, policies, procedures, regulations, licensing requirements, and other governing standards.

11. Provide strategic oversight of cultivation, processing, retail, and distribution operations through the Operations Manager and Cultivation Manager.

12. Ensure appropriate internal controls are maintained to safeguard company assets, inventory, cash, equipment, and confidential information.

13. Monitor product quality standards throughout cultivation, processing, packaging, distribution, and retail operations.

14. Evaluate operational processes and implement improvements that increase productivity, reduce costs, improve quality, and support sustainable business growth.

15. Coordinate with Human Resources regarding recruitment, employee relations, performance management, training, disciplinary actions, and organizational development.

16. Foster a positive workplace culture that promotes teamwork, accountability, professionalism, respect, and employee engagement.

17. Review and approve departmental purchasing requests and operational expenditures within delegated authority.

18. Collaborate with Bay Mills Business Holdings leadership on strategic initiatives, capital improvements, marketing opportunities, and business development projects.

19. Prepare reports and recommendations regarding financial performance, operational activities, compliance matters, and strategic initiatives.

20. Provide leadership and operational support throughout the facility as needed.

21. Respond to operational issues, customer concerns, employee matters, and other business challenges in a timely and professional manner.

22. Maintain current knowledge of cannabis industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices.

23. Provide hands-on operational assistance when business needs require while maintaining primary responsibility for leadership and strategic oversight.

24. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope and complexity of this position.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk and stand, with occasional sitting. The employee must occasionally squat, crawl, crouch, and kneel, and frequently bend, climb, balance, and push/pull. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds and frequently lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. The employee is regularly exposed to dust, plant materials, varying temperatures and humidity, cold temperatures in freezers and coolers, moving machinery, moderate noise, heat, moisture, chemicals, and odors associated with cannabis cultivation, processing, manufacturing, and packaging. The employee may experience cuts, burns, sprains, and strains.

 

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

1. Must be a minimum of 21 years of age.

2. Must have a minimum of a B.S. degree in Cannabis Business, Business Administration or relevant field.

3. Must have a minimum of five (5) years of supervisory experience leading multiple departments or operational teams.

4. Experience working in a vertically integrated cannabis operation preferred

5. Must demonstrate experience developing and managing budgets, financial reports, operational planning, and business performance metrics.

6. Must have working knowledge of inventory management, purchasing, retail, cultivation, distribution, compliance, and internal controls.

7. Must demonstrate strong leadership, organizational, communication, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills.

8. Must pass all required background checks and be licenses by the Bay Mills Cannabis Commission.

9. Must be proficient in computer usage, including Microsoft applications

10. Must have an excellent past work record, including attendance with Bay Mills Indian Community.

 

**WORK SCHEDULE:**

Full-time; 52 weeks per year. In addition to regular business hours, the person in this position must be flexible around the needs of the employer, which may include occasional evening and/or weekend hours or occasional travel for employer business.
